I attached an editable doc with inline comments (RI_Counter_Redlines_20261130.docx). Please add one-line positions in the doc by 9am PST Tuesday so I can synthesize a short counter.

Key points to decide:
- Indemnity scope: Lattice wants carveouts for model-related claims. Legal preference: keep mutual IP indemnity but propose narrower language for model misuse.
- Consequential cap: they want 12 months' cap — we prefer a per-contract liability cap (12 months revenue) plus carveouts for gross negligence.
- Sub-processor notice: accept quarterly disclosure but push to 14-day notice for critical new processors (security-sensitive).
- SOW credits: redline to specific SLAs and cap credits at one month's services; avoid open-ended credits.

Attachments: RI_Counter_Redlines_20261130.docx (editable)

Sara / team — thanks for the redlines and the checklist. We completed an internal review and attached a concise counter (PDF) that highlights the redline positions we consider negotiable vs. non-starters. High-level summary: 

- MSA: Acceptable to agree to narrower indemnity for model outputs limited to direct misuse that breaches customer-provided prompts/data. We cannot accept broad carveouts that eliminate Redwood's IP protections. Proposed change: "Indemnity limited to claims arising from Customer data or Customer instructions to the model."
- Consequential damages: propose a mutual cap equal to 12 months of billable fees under the SOW rather than unlimited or time-based only. Carveouts for willful misconduct and gross negligence remain.
- DPA: We accept quarterly sub-processor disclosures; counter-propose 30-day notice for new critical sub-processors and 90 days for routine additions.
- SOW: Clarified acceptance criteria with measurable test cases in Appendix A; credit schedule limited to up to one invoice cycle (one month) per missed milestone; require failure to meet 3 consecutive monthly SLAs before credits apply.

Attachments: Redwood_Counter_Redlines_20261201.pdf (3 pages) — shows line-by-line comments and a short mutual action plan. Also linking a draft DocuSign envelope for signatures.

Requested next steps:
1) Please confirm which items are deal-breakers so we can escalate.
2) If acceptable, we can route the redlined MSA + DPA for an expedited DocuSign review. Proposed DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/XYZ-123-REDACT (live after you OK counters).

If Lattice wants a short procurement/legal sync, we're available Wed 9–11am PST.

Regards,
